body.description: Explore Cedar Valley district files across protection, sensitive content, school eligibility, external sharing, and handling. The host supplies trusted identity and authorization facts.

A district-wide fictional example for files across Oakwood, Pinecrest, Riverside, and the district office. Protection rolls up by maximum sensitivity; sensitive content and handling combine; school and external-recipient permissions intersect. Markings describe policy inputs while the host application supplies identity, record relationships, assignments, and delivery facts.
body.name: Cedar Valley District Files

body.definition: This exact version is approved for anyone to read or share. An unmarked file is not automatically public.
body.guidance: Use for a published lunch menu, school calendar, or released practice questions.
body.name: Public

body.definition: Routine Cedar Valley business that has not been approved for public distribution.
body.guidance: Use for a staff plan, district memo, or bus operations schedule without student names or home addresses.
body.name: Internal

body.definition: Private information that must be protected from unauthorized disclosure.
body.guidance: Use for student records, employee evaluations, or nonpublic purchasing information. The host application still verifies the reader’s record relationship or approved business purpose.
body.name: Confidential

body.definition: Information needing the strongest protection because disclosure could compromise safety, an investigation, or an assessment.
body.guidance: Use for building access codes, an active investigation file, or live assessment questions. The host application verifies explicit assignment to the file, case, assessment, or team.
body.name: Restricted

body.definition: Protected information about identifiable students, including learning, support, attendance, or individual results.
body.guidance: Access to one student’s information does not grant access to every student. The host application supplies the record relationship.
body.name: Student information

body.definition: Private information about individual employees or personnel matters.
body.guidance: Use for an employee evaluation or personnel investigation. The host application supplies the record or case authorization.
body.name: Employee information

body.definition: Nonpublic purchasing, payment, or financial information.
body.guidance: Use for supplier bids or evaluation notes during an active purchasing review. A published budget does not need this tag.
body.name: Financial information

body.definition: Unreleased questions, answer keys, and other controlled assessment material.
body.guidance: Use for a live assessment booklet or its answer key. The host application verifies assignment to the assessment.
body.name: Secure assessments

body.definition: Details that could expose people, buildings, or systems to harm.
body.guidance: Use for door access codes or security-system blind spots. The host application verifies a reader’s operational need.
body.name: Security information

body.definition: A finite group containing Oakwood Middle School, Pinecrest Middle School, and Riverside High School. It is not a wildcard or an access grant.
body.guidance: Use ALL by itself for a file permitted at all three schools. Combined markings retain only schools permitted by every contributing marking; permission for all three is displayed as ALL.
body.name: All three schools

body.definition: Permitted for Oakwood Middle School. Other protection and access requirements still apply.
body.guidance: Use for an Oakwood staffing plan or include it with another school when both may receive the file.
body.name: Oakwood Middle School

body.definition: Permitted for Pinecrest Middle School. Other protection and access requirements still apply.
body.guidance: Use for a Pinecrest file or include it with another school when both may receive the file.
body.name: Pinecrest Middle School

body.definition: Permitted for Riverside High School. Other protection and access requirements still apply.
body.guidance: Use for a Riverside file or include it with another school when both may receive the file.
body.name: Riverside High School

body.definition: The implicit internal recipient for every nonpublic Cedar Valley file. Authors do not select it; the scheme derives it from Internal, Confidential, or Restricted protection.
body.guidance: Its presence makes blank external sharing district-only and preserves district access when an external organization is also permitted.
body.name: Cedar Valley District (implicit)

body.definition: Allows delivery to authorized staff of the fictional state education department, in addition to authorized Cedar Valley recipients.
body.guidance: Use only when this exact nonpublic file may be shared with the department. The marking does not establish a recipient’s identity or business need.
body.name: Commonwealth Education Department

body.definition: Allows delivery to authorized staff of Cedar Valley’s contracted transportation provider, in addition to authorized Cedar Valley recipients.
body.guidance: Use for an approved provider copy such as a bus operations plan without student names or home addresses. The marking does not verify the recipient.
body.name: Student Transportation Services

body.definition: Do not pass this copy on. Ask the owner before distributing it further.
body.guidance: A human instruction for material such as an internal purchasing memo circulated for review. The marking does not technically block forwarding.
body.name: Do not forward

body.definition: Remove protected information and obtain approval for a separate public version. This copy stays protected.
body.guidance: A human instruction for material such as a purchasing report with private contact or payment information. The marking does not perform redaction.
body.name: Redact before release

body.definition: Keep the packet closed until its authorized opening time or event.
body.guidance: A human instruction for a live assessment packet awaiting its scheduled session. The marking does not run a clock or verify the seal.
body.name: Keep sealed

body.definition: Collect every issued copy after the authorized activity and return it to its custodian.
body.guidance: A human instruction for controlled packets or temporary plans. The marking does not prove that every copy was returned.
body.name: Collect after use
